plain.li: I told {OTHER_nameDef} the thing I've never told a soul. {OTHER_nameDef} listened to all of it, then put a hand on my shoulder.
I said it out loud tonight, to {OTHER_nameDef}. The roof didn't fall in.
[night] Couldn't sleep, so I told {OTHER_nameDef}. All of it. I think I'll sleep now.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} knows now, and still smiled at me over breakfast.

blunt.li: Told {OTHER_nameDef}. If it gets out, I'll know who.

cheerful.li: I told {OTHER_nameDef} my secret and nothing terrible happened! It's like putting down a sack of stone.

gloomy.li: I told {OTHER_nameDef}. Now there are two of us carrying it. I'm not sure that was fair.

cold.li: Disclosed to {OTHER_nameDef}. A calculated risk. I trust the calculation.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} told me something tonight. I won't write it here. I won't write it anywhere.
I know a thing about {OTHER_nameDef} now that the others don't. It explains a lot.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} trusted me with the hardest thing. I'll carry it as carefully as I can.

blunt.li: {OTHER_nameDef} told me a secret. It stays with me. End of entry.

cheerful.li: I'm keeping a secret for a friend now! I'm not even going to hint at it, not even here.

gloomy.li: {OTHER_nameDef} told me a hard thing tonight. I lay awake with it.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef} disclosed something significant. Leverage I won't use. Probably.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} told them. Now the talking stops whenever I walk into a room.
It's out. Years of keeping it, and it took {OTHER_nameDef} one careless evening.

warm.li: It's out. A few of the others have been kind about it, which I didn't expect.

blunt.li: {OTHER_nameDef} has a big mouth. Fine. Let them all look.

cheerful.li: Well, it's out! I'm going to go weed the far field for a while.

gloomy.li: I knew it would come out. I just hoped I'd be dead first.

cold.li: Exposed, via {OTHER_nameDef}. I'll adjust. I'll also remember.

plain.li: I said it at breakfast, to all of them. I hadn't planned to, and it was out before the bread came round.
I stood up at supper and told them. Then I sat back down and finished my soup, because I didn't know what else to do.

warm.li: I told them all the truth. Whatever they think of me now, at least it's me they're thinking it about.

blunt.li: Told everyone. Done hiding. Anyone with a problem can say it to my face.

gloomy.li: I told them. Now I wait to see who stops speaking to me.

plain.li: I kept {OTHER_nameDef}'s secret for as long as {OTHER_nameDef} lived. Now I've told it. I hope that was right.
{OTHER_nameDef} can't be hurt by it anymore. So I told them what I knew. They should know who {OTHER_nameDef} really was.

gloomy.li: The secret outlived {OTHER_nameDef}. Now it's just a story.

plain.li: {FACTION} killed {OTHER_nameDef}. I've written their name at the top of this page.
I made {OTHER_nameDef} a promise at the grave. {FACTION} will pay.

warm.li: I don't want to hate anyone. But {FACTION} took {OTHER_nameDef}, and I do.

blunt.li: {FACTION}. Every one of them I see from now on is mine.

cheerful.li: There's no bright side to this. {FACTION} killed {OTHER_nameDef}, and I won't smile again until they've paid.

gloomy.li: {FACTION} took {OTHER_nameDef}. Revenge won't bring anyone back. I want it anyway.

cold.li: {FACTION} owes me for {OTHER_nameDef}. I intend to collect.

plain.li: {FACTION} carried {OTHER_nameDef} off. Alive, maybe. I'm not sleeping until we know.
They took {OTHER_nameDef}. The last I saw, {FACTION} had {OTHER_objective} over a shoulder, and I'm going to get {OTHER_objective} back.

blunt.li: {FACTION} has {OTHER_nameDef}. That's a mistake they'll regret.

plain.li: {FACTION} has paid for {LOST}. I feel lighter than I did, but mostly I just miss {LOST}.
It's done. I went to {LOST}'s grave and told {LOST} so.

cold.li: The account with {FACTION} is closed. {LOST} is avenged.

plain.li: The council made peace with {FACTION}. The same {FACTION} that killed {LOST}. I can't look at any of them right now.
Peace with {FACTION}. As if {LOST} never mattered.

blunt.li: Peace with {FACTION}. Not mine. Never mine.

cold.li: The council has its reasons for peace with {FACTION}. I have mine for not forgiving it.

plain.li: I spoke at {OTHER_nameDef}'s grave today. My voice held, mostly.
They asked me to say something for {OTHER_nameDef}. I tried to say the true things.
I'd planned what to say about {OTHER_nameDef} all morning. When it came to it, I mostly told the story about the river crossing.

gloomy.li: I said goodbye to {OTHER_nameDef} at the grave, with all of them listening. Then I came here and said it again, properly.
